_comment: LIVE pack changelog for the main-menu Announcements screen (Core reads this; overrides the jar-bundled fallback). Newest entry first. Edit per release. Keep it short, warm and player-facing — write like a person, no mod names, no filler. Entries whose version does NOT start with a digit render as a TEASER ('On the horizon' instead of 'Added', no v prefix).

entries.title: Still in the workshop
added: Speak in proximity voice and watch your words appear above your head
Chat with anyone — we'll translate across languages for you
…and a few more secrets we're keeping rolled up for now

entries.title: Guns, Gears & Guardrails
added: Big cannons are here — build them, mount them, and fire them from the deck of your airship
Radar dishes to sweep the skies and spot what is coming before it reaches you
Escalators, because ladders were getting old
Build faster with a new placement assist, and browse resource packs without leaving the game
A proper screenshot viewer, so your best shots are one click away
fixed: The updater now clears out mods and files that older versions left behind
Old map data from the previous world no longer bleeds into the new one
removed: A handful of experimental extras that were causing crashes — the skies are steadier for it

entries.title: Forge & Feast
added: A whole industrial age — factories, power grids, solar arrays and heavy machinery to build out
Cook properly at last: a full kitchen, a tavern, a café and a confectionery, plus three new spreads of hearty food
New ways to get around — hypertubes, dash panels, rails, and a parachute for when it all goes wrong
Submarines, for when the fight belongs below the waves
A shipwright's toolkit: precision building tools and new gear for handling your airship
Mine a whole vein in one swing
Deep-sea and abyssal decor, plus more girders to frame it all
A smoother interface, a tidier hotbar, and notes you can scribble in-game
fixed: Kitchen items that were rendering wrong now look right
Steadier server performance, and the world loads noticeably faster than before

entries.title: Dragon's Due
added: The Ender Dragon got a glow-up — a fierce new look awaits when the End opens
Teleport cinematics now play only at waystones — everything else is instant
Crafting conflicts now ask which item you meant instead of guessing wrong
Something stirs behind the End's locked door…
fixed: A big FPS boost — two new optimizations under the hood
Fixed a crash some players were hitting mid-flight
Smoother performance out in the wilds — and /rtp now queues politely
Player faces now show up in the Tab list
removed: Storms and tornadoes — they were eating your frames (and your chests). Calmer skies for now
Wildfire and a few woodland critters — trimmed for performance while we tune the server
The animal animation packs — some critters looked broken with them; they'll return polished

entries.title: Skies Alight
added: The world can burn now — volcanoes, geysers, hot springs and wildfire (build with care!)
Real wind and storms that shove your airships around the sky
New Create gear: goggles, jetpacks and gyroscope stabilisers to keep your ship steady
Framed blocks, hundreds of new block variants and fresh armour trims to make it yours
A wider world to explore — richer biomes, winding trails and towns & towers to discover
Deliver goods by airship across the map
A warm new brass look for your inventory and workbench screens
Instant, cinematic teleports to zip across the world
fixed: Smoother, steadier flying and airship physics
Using shaders? Type /flywheel backend off for glowing Create lasers
